Strategy filing · 2026-11-09

Activity 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 · balances 2026-11-08 · 8-K 0001193125-26-452693. Producer assembled 2026-11-09T16:03:18Z.

USD Cash $146,200,000 · USD Reserve $4,770,000,000 (separately disclosed balances). MSTR ATM 2051348 shares / $283,800,000 net; $81,900,000 to BTC and $13,600,000 to USD Cash. STRC repurchases 1887464 shares / $188,300,000. Preferred dividend cash use $21,100,000 across preferred stock, not STRC alone.

BTC purchased 1036; holdings 850364, versus 849327 previously: increase 1037. Reconciliation: unreconciled; no sale, loss or rounding explanation is inferred. Historical acquisition cost $64,160,000,000 / average $75,456. Issuer historical acquisition cost inclusive of fees; not a current BTC market mark.

Remaining preferred repurchase authorization $560,300,000; common authorization $1,000,000,000. Buyback authorizations are not cash; available ATM capacity is not committed financing.

Includes shares sold but not yet settled as of November 6, 2026.

Owner-reviewed cash arithmetic: balance change $13,500,000 versus reported cash allocation $13,600,000. Residual $-100,000, unresolved; arithmetic does not identify its cause.

Other model clocks: debt 2026-08-09; preferred base 2026-06-30. This weekly filing does not refresh every liability input. BTC market source coingecko; BTC quote clock not provided by producer; MSTR quote fetched 2026-11-09T16:00:03Z.

Outstanding-share limitation: Not verified by repurchase disclosure; current outstanding and forward burden unavailable. Exact base 104894705 shares at 2026-06-30; base age 132 days. NOT DERIVED: repurchases do not verify retirement/cancellation or current outstanding.

Meeting approval, filed/effective terms and actual declaration require separate evidence. Daily and replaced semi-monthly payments must not be added together.

RiskAnalyst review for filing 2026-11-09 · owner local review date 2026-11-10: Common-equity access funded this week’s STRC repurchases and allowed a modest general-cash rebuild, improving on the prior depletion. One positive week does not establish sustained rebuilding or a durable funding mix. Retain MSTR Funding 3.0 / Overall 3.5 and STRC Counterparty 3.0 / Overall 3.0; no automatic downstream rescore. Current STRC outstanding, dependent dividend burden and runway remain unverified/unavailable. Scores and full-verification dates are unchanged.
